visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Items Left in One Half Are Dropped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Sorting 38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10 should keep all seven numbers, but the program prints a shorter list.

solution.explanation: The merge loop stops as soon as one half is used up, but the other half may still have items. They are already sorted and must be appended, otherwise they are lost.
